description: Robert's experiment bringing up Invenio RDM v14 (latest release candidate) under Granian instead of uWSGI/Gunicorn, provisioned on AWS via clasm, managed via uv. Free-threaded Python 3.14t was tried and abandoned (SQLAlchemy's own bundled C extension re-enables the GIL process-wide); runs on standard Python 3.14 instead. v0.0.1: proof of concept live-verified end to end, including reboot-survivable systemd hardening.
name: granian-rdm-v14
releaseNotes: Fixed cloud-init.yaml size issue with AWS launch templates
